feeds.title: The DIY Mommy » Craft
feeds.description: My name is Christina Dennis and I created The DIY Mommy. It features DIY home decor tutorials, home organization ideas, unique craft ideas, fun kids' activity ideas, free sewing patterns, easy family recipe ideas, free printable artwork, blogging advice, budget lifestyle tips and so much more.

feeds.title: Creative Scrapbooker Magazine
feeds.description: Creative Scrapbooker Magazine is a technique-rich paper crafting magazine that features scrapbooking, card making, stamping, and mixed media projects. Creative Scrapbooker Magazine keeps you up-to-date on all things creative.

feeds.title: A Pretty Fix
feeds.description: I'm Jelica. Welcome to A Pretty Fix, a home DIY blog about making crafts, decor, and how-tos accessible and fun. Here you'll find ideas, tips, and inspiration to live life more beautifully.

feeds.title: SuNN Stampin'
feeds.description: Hi, I am Susanne. I am addicted to rubber stamping, card making, coloring and all things paper crafty. I teach card making workshops, try to inspire creativity, and love seeing people fall in love with my hobby.

feeds.title: Alberta Craft Council Blog
feeds.description: The Alberta Craft Council is the Provincial Arts Service Organization that develops, promotes, and advocates for Fine Craft in Alberta.

feeds.title: Sugar, Spice and Glitter » Crafts
feeds.description: Easy kids' craft ideas, from backyard bird feeder wreaths to homemade bath bombs and more! Crafts kids can actually do, with simple instructions and easy set-up

feeds.title: Craft NB Blog
feeds.description: Craft NB is a non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting excellence in crafts, maintaining standards of craftsmanship, and expanding markets for fine crafts.

feeds.title: The Papercraftsman Blog
feeds.description: The Papercraftsman, aka Braden Lutz, is a Canadian gamer who enjoys making papercraft models of things and characters from his favorite videogames. He then created this website to share his creations with others who might enjoy them.

feeds.title: Happy Crafters Canada Blog
feeds.description: Happy Crafters Canada is your source for all of your Iron-On and Adhesive Vinyl needs. We carry a variety of colors, finishes, and sheet sizes to fit any project. Our goal at Happy Crafters is to give you the tools you need to Make Something With Us!

feeds.title: Kelly Creates
feeds.description: I am Kelly. Teaching, writing, designing, crafting, hand lettering, and art....my creative journey is always exciting! I have also partnered with American Crafts to develop an educational line of hand lettering and calligraphy products...pens, workbooks, practice pads, stamps, journals, and more!

feeds.title: The Crafty Medic Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Stefanie and I'm a paper craft addict! I create (and send) hundreds of cards every year to people all over the world. I share these with you all in hopes of bringing joy, love, and a little sass to your life.
